newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian bonds dip as short rates climb.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian bonds dip as short rates climb.

text.p: Norwegian bonds closed lower with volume picking up from Tuesday's dull session.
"The market was quite calm, but some selling emerged and widened the yield gap versus Bunds," said one analyst.
The Norwegian crown was stable at 102.1 against the European Currency Unit index, compared to 102.2 last Friday.
"It appears that the crown is stuck at this level at the moment, and it looks like bonds won't get any help from lower short rates," said the analyst.
